RagShortTexts: Once the splendid jewel of the Umayyad Caliphate, Córdoba served as a premier Christian.

Variants.Content: Recaptured in 1236, Córdoba bridged Islamic splendour and Christian frontier chivalry along the Guadalquivir. Within its vast forest of bi-colored arches, the Mezquita served as a magnificent cathedral overlooking fertile olive plains.
Renowned Mudéjar tanners perfected supple cordovan leather, supplying elite European footwear and horse gear markets.
